title: Act: Add checkAssetRefs to the manifest loader
summary: Export checkAssetRefs returning issues for refs missing from the manifest
description: Add a pure helper next to loadManifestFile that compares a list of asset refs to manifest ids.
acceptance_criteria: checkAssetRefs returns one issue per unknown ref
checkAssetRefs returns [] when all refs exist

steps.action: Append exported function checkAssetRefs(manifest: AssetManifest, refs: readonly string[]): ManifestIssue[] that builds a Set of manifest.assets ids and returns one issue per ref not in the set.
steps.expected: npx tsc --noEmit in game passes and the function is exported.
